primaryIntent: Understand how a government organization or prime contractor buys from ThatDeveloperGuy
title: Government Solutions — ThatDeveloperGuy
description: How government organizations and prime contractors scope, contract and receive IT, cybersecurity and software work from ThatDeveloperGuy LLC.
heading: Government Solutions
summary: Planning, requirements, contracting and delivery for agencies and the primes that serve them.

sections.heading: Government solutions
sections.body: Websites, internal applications, workplace IT and security work for public organizations, scoped to the requirement and delivered with the records a reviewer expects.

sections.heading: Project planning
sections.body: Scope, schedule and acceptance criteria are written down before work starts. Changes are recorded, not absorbed.

sections.heading: Review requirements
sections.body: Accessibility, records retention, security review and hosting constraints are read from the solicitation and confirmed with the buyer.

sections.heading: Contracting and capability statement
sections.body: Procurement identifiers (CAGE, SAM.gov registration status, NAICS codes, set-aside status) are shown here only once the owner supplies and verifies them.

sections.heading: Delivery process
sections.body: Discovery, build, review, handover. Each step ends with something the buyer can inspect.

sections.heading: Government websites and workplace IT
sections.body: Public sites, staff tools and the machines and networks that run them.
